Name: Vite
OneLiner: Fast dev server and production bundler for modern front-end projects.
BestFor: New React, Vue, Svelte or vanilla projects
Instant hot reload on large codebases
NotIdealFor: Heavy webpack-specific plugin ecosystems you cannot replace
TokenTips: Use `vite build --report` style analysers to find heavy dependencies
Split vendor code with manual chunks only when measurements show a gain

Name: Next.js
OneLiner: React framework with routing, server rendering and API routes built in.
BestFor: Content or e-commerce sites needing SEO
Full-stack React apps with one deployment
NotIdealFor: Pure static sites that need no React
Teams that do not want server rendering complexity
TokenTips: Prefer server components for data fetching
Use the image component and font optimisation for Core Web Vitals

Name: Playwright
OneLiner: Reliable end-to-end browser testing for Chromium, Firefox and WebKit.
BestFor: Testing real user flows across browsers
Screenshot and trace debugging of flaky tests
NotIdealFor: Very fast feedback loops (use unit tests)
TokenTips: Test user-visible behaviour, not implementation details
Run in CI with traces enabled on retry

Name: Lighthouse
OneLiner: Audits a page's performance, accessibility, best practices and SEO.
BestFor: Quick health checks of a page
Tracking Core Web Vitals regressions in CI
NotIdealFor: Measuring real users (use field data such as CrUX)
TokenTips: Test on throttled mobile settings, not your fast laptop
Fix the biggest opportunity first rather than chasing a perfect score

Name: TypeScript
TokenTips: Prefer inferred types; annotate function boundaries

Name: Chrome DevTools
OneLiner: Built-in browser tools for inspecting the DOM, network, performance and memory.
BestFor: Finding slow requests and long tasks
TokenTips: Use the Performance panel's recording instead of guessing
Throttle CPU and network to feel what users feel
